lena: Quick heads up  I'm landing a compact migration for Optimize examples: consolidate batching + cache + quant snippets under /optimize/examples and add a migrate.md with old->new mappings. PR incoming.

chris: sweet. will you include tiny performance CSVs? SRE uses those for decisions.

lena: yes, small csv with latency/cost per quant profile and a 2-line guidance table. file: optimize/examples/quant-metrics.csv

morgan: SDK snippets: prefer one Node and one python compact example. also add a curl example for ops.

lena: done. Node snippet is short and shows batchingPolicy + prefix cache + quantProfile. python is one-block. curl is single-line.

priyam: CI note: add linkcheck that allows redirects. previous refactor caused flaky failures.

lena: adding lychee with --allow-redirects and a small htmlproofer step.

docs-bot: Reminder  add changelog entry and label docs:optimize.

lena: changelog added. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120 (wip) tagging @chris @morgan @priyam.
